subject.title: fix(ui): show selected agent default model

question: Should this PR be narrowed to the WebChat selector fix before merge, or are the broad runtime/update/plugin/script changes intentional maintainer-owned work?
rationale: The current head is conflicting and includes many non-UI surfaces under a UI bug title, so automation should not decide whether to preserve or drop those changes without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow and rebase
options.body: Rebase onto current main, drop unrelated runtime/changelog changes, and fix the selector reload/default discrimination before rerunning UI proof.

options.title: Own the broad batch
options.body: Keep the broad branch only if a maintainer intentionally accepts the extra runtime/update/plugin surfaces and validates those areas before merge.

options.title: Replace with a smaller PR
options.body: Close or pause this conflicted branch if a fresh narrow PR would be cheaper than resolving the broad diff safely.

recommendation.title: Narrow and rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, drop unrelated runtime/changelog changes, and fix the selector reload/default discrimination before rerunning UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is both the strongest sampled owner for the selector path and the protected-label PR owner for deciding whether the broad branch is intentional.
